name: HH 270 IRS

images.note: Bipolar outflow cavities + deflected HH 270 jet driven by HH 270 IRS (05:51:34.9 +02:56:42). This is NOT hh270-mms2 (which sits 2+ arcmin away at 05:51:22.6): keep separate. Region boxes A-D are the paper's own annotations; paper also has ALMA 12CO/13CO/C18O maps (figs 5-6) for follow-up records.

paper.title: A Study of HH 270 with the James Webb Space Telescope

notes: Class I protostar driving the deflected HH 270/110 jet system; JWST/NIRCam H2 imaging (Ortiz Capeles et al. 2026) resolves the bipolar outflow cavities. Distinct from HH270 MMS2 (~3 arcmin away).
